findings.title: Migration crashes with NoMethodError when embed_category or uncategorized_category_id is not set in site_settings
findings.body: In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, lines 9-11 and 15 index `[0]['id']` and `[0]['value']` directly on the `PG::Result` returned by `execute(...)`. On any database where `embed_category` has never been saved to `site_settings` (or where `uncategorized_category_id` is not yet in `site_settings`, e.g., a fresh database running migrations from scratch), `execute(...)` returns 0 rows, `result[0]` is `nil` (or raises `IndexError` on `PG::Result`), and `['id']` / `['value']` raises an exception, aborting `rake db:migrate`. Additionally, on line 25, `h` is interpolated directly into the `INSERT` SQL without stripping `http(s)://` or paths (which the new `EmbeddableHost` model's `before_validation` does) or escaping quotes.

findings.title: before_validation raises NoMethodError when host is nil and does not lowercase host for record_for_host
findings.body: In `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`, the `before_validation` callback calls `self.host.sub!(...)` unconditionally on lines 6-7, which raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'sub!' for nil:NilClass` if `host` is `nil` instead of failing validation cleanly. Also, in `record_for_host` (lines 14-17), `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` compares `lower(host)` against `uri.host` without downcasing `uri.host` (or normalizing port numbers, which the format validator on line 2 allows in `EmbeddableHost#host` while `URI#host` strips the port), so uppercase characters in the input URL or a stored `:port` will cause `record_for_host` and `host_allowed?` to fail to match.

findings.title: Contents of category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb are swapped
findings.body: `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` was overwritten with `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)` while the category fabricators (`:category`, `:diff_category`, `:happy_category`, `:private_category`) were placed in `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb`. The two files have each other's contents.

findings.title: Test 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' no longer tests what it describes
findings.body: In `spec/models/topic_spec.rb` line 1403, the spec `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` passes only because `SiteSetting.embed_truncate` defaults to `false` and `has_topic_embed?` is `false` on the unpersisted topic. `Topic#expandable_first_post?` no longer checks `EmbeddableHost` at all (`SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`), so this test is misleading and redundant with the tests inside the `with an emeddable host` block.
